{{Infobox character | name = Galena | image = Galena.png | race = Hearthian | planet = Timber Hearth | location = Village }}__NOTOC__ '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Hearthian child. They and their friend [[Tephra]] can be found with their radios sitting on the front porch of a house. Their friend, Tephra, asks [[the Protagonist]] to play hide and seek with them using their radios and the Protagonist's [[signalscope]]. Galena is characterized as somewhat shy, given their lack of dialogue, and what dialogue they speak is in smaller font size. == Dialogue == === Introduction dialog === * “...” === Secondary dialog === * “...
Good luck in space” === Follow-up dialog === * “...” === Hide & Seek: Finding Them First === * “...
You found me...” === Hide & Seek: Finding Them Last === * “...I won? I’m happy...
Thanks... for playing with us.” == Trivia == * [[wikipedia:Galena|Galena]] is a mineral typically used to make Crystal radios, a type of radio that requires no power, but therefore is quiet, due to lack of amplification. Such radios were common in early days of radio development. This is a reference to the fact that Galena plays a game with the signalscope, a radio parallel within the Outer Wilds universe. It is also likely a reference to the fact that Galena is a much quieter character than the other Hearthians, apparent in their smaller text. [[Category:Characters]] [[Category:Hearthians]]
